label: Tolerance omission model of actual-world Euclidean access and its chained reading
paraphrase: Closed mathematical controls on three origin offsets (minus, actual, plus), natural-number times, every individual counted concrete. (1) Under access iff the offsets differ by at most one step, the tolerance rival holds at actual, actual accesses itself, and access is not Euclidean at actual. (2) On a history over it in which one individual exists at actual and plus and is present there at every time, and another exists at plus only and is present there only at time 1, presence-to-existence, inert emptiness and the possible contingent-free past at actual hold, and no individual exists at actual and at every world accessible from actual. (3) With the same assignment under the chained frame (every offset accesses every offset), Euclidean access at actual holds, the possible contingent-free past at actual fails, and the conclusion still fails. Statements about these finite interpretations only.
